name: Dublin City University
summary: Dublin 9 university with about 85 undergraduate courses, from Computing, Data Science and Engineering to Business and Journalism, through CAO.

ib.text: Six subjects including English (or Irish) and Maths; no third language in general. Strictest: Actuarial Mathematics HL Maths 6; Global Business (Germany) HL German 5; Computer Science Maths SL 5 or HL 4.

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Algorithms, software engineering, cloud computing, networks and systems architecture, with machine learning and cybersecurity later on, plus a paid six-month INTRA work placement in year 3.
programmes.ib: Maths SL 5 or HL 4, inside the CAO's general IB rule of 3 HL at 5 and 3 SL at 4.
programmes.selectionNote: Places go on CAO points; your IB total is converted with the CAO's points table.

flagshipSource.title: DCU Computer Science: paid six-month INTRA work placement, graduate employment and further study figures

programmes.name: Actuarial Mathematics
programmes.about: Calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics and computing in years 1 and 2, then applied methods for insurance, finance and banking; year 3 is an eight-month paid INTRA placement.
programmes.ib: HL Maths 6, inside the CAO's general IB rule of 3 HL at 5 and 3 SL at 4.
programmes.selectionNote: Places go on CAO points; graduates may be exempt from some or all of the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries' Core Principles exams.

flagshipSource.title: DCU Actuarial Mathematics: accredited by the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries, with an eight-month paid placement

programmes.name: Journalism
programmes.about: Reporting and writing for digital, social, print and broadcast, with media law, ethics and the politics and society you report on; radio and television studios, mock news days and a mandatory eight-week media placement.
programmes.ib: English at HL 5 (the CAO equivalent of Leaving Cert H4), inside the CAO's general IB rule of 3 HL at 5 and 3 SL at 4.
programmes.selectionNote: Places go on CAO points; the eight-week placement is arranged or approved by DCU through its INTRA programme.

flagshipSource.title: DCU Journalism: radio and TV studios, mock news days and a mandatory media placement

faculties.name: DCU Business School
faculties.line: Global Business (Germany) asks HL German 5 and Maths SL 5 or HL 4, for native speakers too; it adds two internships.

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering and Computing
faculties.line: Computer Science asks Maths SL 5 or HL 4 and includes a paid INTRA work placement.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science and Health
faculties.line: Actuarial Mathematics asks HL Maths 6 and includes an eight-month paid INTRA placement.

faculties.name: Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences
faculties.line: Journalism asks English at HL 5 and includes a mandatory eight-week media placement.

faculties.name: DCU Institute of Education
faculties.line: Primary Teaching (DC002) asks Irish at H4 (IB HL 5 on the CAO table) as well as English and Maths.

notes: DCU takes an IB through CAO when it was awarded within Europe, so an IB from a school in Denmark is assessed as an EU qualification.
Language requirements bind native speakers too: Global Business (Germany) asks H4 in German, IB HL 5, whatever language your school taught in.
